<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

type="module" id="interactions-loader-%3AR5%3A">const configElement = document.getElementById(`interactions-config-%3AR5%3A`)
if (configElement) {
  const entries = JSON.parse(configElement.textContent)
  const [{ Interact }, legacyPresets, presets] = await Promise.all([
    import(`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@wix/interact@2.8.2/dist/es/web.min.js`),
    import(`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@wix/wix-motion-presets@1.10.0/+esm`),
    import(`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@wix/motion-presets@1.1.0/dist/browser/motion-presets.min.js`),
  ])
  if (configElement.isConnected) {
    const aliasedLegacyPresets = {}
    for (const name of Object.keys(legacyPresets)) {
      aliasedLegacyPresets[`LEGACY_` + name] = legacyPresets[name]
    }
    Interact.registerEffects({ ...presets, ...aliasedLegacyPresets })
    Interact.forceReducedMotion = false
    Interact.setup({
      scrollOptionsGetter: function () {
        return document.getElementById(`site-root`)
      },
      allowA11yTriggers: true,
      viewEnter: {
        useSafeViewEnter: true,
      },
    })
    entries.forEach(function (entry, index) {
      const options = {
        configIndex: entries.length === 1 ? undefined : index,
        reducedMotionPolicy: entry.reducedMotionPolicy,
      }
      if (!entry.disableQuery) {
        Interact.create(entry.config, options)
        return
      }
      const disabled = window.matchMedia(entry.disableQuery)
      let instance
      const stop = function () {
        if (instance) {
          instance.destroy()
          instance = undefined
        }
      }
      const update = function () {
        if (disabled.matches) {
          stop()
        } else if (!instance) {
          instance = Interact.create(entry.config, options)
        }
      }
      update()
      disabled.addEventListener(`change`, update)
      configElement.addEventListener(`interactions-teardown`, function () {
        disabled.removeEventListener(`change`, update)
        stop()
      }, { once: true })
    })
  }
